sources.title: The profitability of technical trading rules in the Bitcoin market
sources.authors: Dirk F. Gerritsen; Elie Bouri; E. Ramezanifar; D. Roubaud
sources.relevance: Finds trading-range breakout among the strongest trend-following rules in Bitcoin.

sources.title: Systematic Trend-Following with Adaptive Portfolio Construction: Enhancing Risk-Adjusted Alpha in Cryptocurrency Markets
sources.relevance: Motivates 6-hour crypto trend decisions, volatility scaling, and asymmetric long-short allocation.

hypothesis: A causal trading-range breakout state, rebalanced every six hours and inverse-volatility scaled across liquid Binance perpetuals, earns positive net returns because crypto trends persist after range expansion.
mechanism: Slow information diffusion and positive-feedback positioning create persistent price trends after prices escape a multi-day trading range; volatility scaling reduces domination by the most volatile coins.
universe: Point-in-time assets with exact hourly history and top 80 percent by lagged trailing 30-day close*volume; minimum 8 assets.
signal: At execution time t, use prior close t-1. Enter/retain long state if prior close exceeds the maximum high of the preceding channel excluding t-1; enter/retain short state if prior close is below the analogous prior low. State persists until the opposite breakout.
rebalance: Every 6 hours at current open using only completed prior-hour information.
construction: Inverse-volatility weights. Long side gross target 0.70, short side gross target 0.30 when each side is present; no reallocation of a missing side.
development_gate: Canonical base-cost net Sharpe > 0.70, canonical net total return > 0, and at least 2 of 3 preregistered channel windows have positive net development return.
funding_treatment: Historical funding rates are unavailable in this panel. The result cannot be promoted beyond exploratory unless funding sensitivity is bounded separately; transaction cost sensitivity is still mandatory.
